report.description: A report produced for a patient enrollment, for example an EFS report. One row per report. Use it to find a report's status, type, hold state, its file attachment, or which enrollment it belongs to. Sorted by creation date by default.

ReportNumber.description: The report's own number (a whole number, e.g. 5521). This is what users type to identify a report.

ReportStatus.description: Current workflow status of the report.

OnHold.description: True if the report is currently on hold.

OnHoldBy.description: User who put the report on hold.

OnHoldReason.description: Free-text reason the report was put on hold.

AttachmentId.description: ID (GUID) of the attachment that holds the report file.

AttachmentType.description: Type of the report's file attachment.

ObjectType.description: What kind of object the report file is attached to.

ContentType.description: File format of the report file, for example application/pdf.

EnrollmentNumber.description: Number of the enrollment this report belongs to.

EnrollmentId.description: Internal ID (GUID) of the enrollment this report belongs to. Users never type this; use it to find the enrollment's details (query enrollment with EnrollmentId).

EnrollmentStatus.description: Status of the enrollment this report belongs to.

DeviceType.description: Type of device used for the enrollment, for example Holter or MCT.

Facility.description: Facility (clinic or hospital) the report is for.

enrollment.description: A patient enrollment (monitoring episode). One row per enrollment. Use it for enrollment status, billing method/status, device type, facility, and to see which orders, reports and attachments belong to it.

EnrollmentId.description: Internal ID (GUID) of the enrollment. Users never type this; use it to find the enrollment's details (query enrollment with EnrollmentId).

EnrollmentNumber.description: The enrollment's own number (a whole number). This is what users type to identify an enrollment.

DeviceType.description: Type of device used for this enrollment, for example Holter or MCT.

Facility.description: Facility (clinic or hospital) the enrollment belongs to.

BillingStatus.description: Current billing status of the enrollment.

PendingAttachmentCount.description: Number of attachments still pending for this enrollment.

OrderNumbers.description: Orders placed for this enrollment. To get order details, query order with EnrollmentNumber.

OrderCount.description: Number of orders for this enrollment.

AttachmentIds.description: IDs of attachments (documents) on this enrollment.

ReportNumbers.description: Reports generated for this enrollment. To get report details, query report with EnrollmentNumber.

ReportTypes.description: Distinct types of reports for this enrollment, for example EFS.

order.description: An order to ship devices/kits to a center or facility. One row per order. Use it for order status, type, center, who created it, the enrollment it belongs to, and which devices, bundles, kits and pre-built kits are in it.

OrderNumber.description: The order's own number (a whole number). This is what users type to identify an order.

OrderStatus.description: Current status of the order, for example Pending, Completed or Cancelled.

Center.description: Distribution center that fulfils the order.

Facility.description: Facility (clinic or hospital) the order is for.

EnrollmentNumber.description: Number of the enrollment this order belongs to.

EnrollmentId.description: Internal ID (GUID) of the enrollment. Users never type this; use it to find the enrollment's details (query enrollment with EnrollmentId).

DeviceSerials.description: Serial numbers of devices in this order. To get device details for all of them, query order_device with OrderNumber.

DeviceCount.description: Number of devices in the order.

BundleCount.description: Number of bundles in the order.

Kits.description: Names of kits in this order.

PBKSerialNumbers.description: Pre-built kits in this order. To get details, query prebuilt_kit with OrderNumber.

PBKCount.description: Number of pre-built kits in the order.

device.description: A physical monitoring device. One row per device serial number. Use it for where a device is (location, center, facility), its type/category/config, and which order, bundle and transfer it is in.

SerialNumber.description: The device's serial number. This is what users type to identify a device.

PartNumber.description: Manufacturer part number of the device.

BundleId.description: Internal GUID of the bundle the device is in (from its latest order). Users never type this; to find devices by bundle number, query prebuilt_kit with BundleNumber first, then device with its BundleId.

OrderNumber.description: The device's LATEST order only. For all orders this device has been in, query order_device with SerialNumber.

OrderNumbers.description: All distinct order numbers for orders containing this device. To get order details, query order with an individual OrderNumber from this list.

OrderCount.description: Number of distinct orders containing this device.

TransferNumber.description: Latest transfer the device was part of.

Location.description: Current storage location of the device.

Center.description: Distribution center that currently holds the device.

DeviceType.description: Kind of device, for example Holter or MCT.

DeviceCategory.description: Category the device type belongs to.

Facility.description: Facility (clinic or hospital) the device is assigned to.

PurchaseOrderNumber.description: Vendor purchase order the device was bought on.

PBKSerialNumber.description: Pre-built kit the device is in (from its latest order). To get PBK details, query prebuilt_kit with PBKSerialNumber.

transfer.description: A transfer of devices from one center to another. One row per transfer. Use it for transfer status, from/to centers, notes, and which devices were moved.

TransferNumber.description: The transfer's own number. This is what users type to identify a transfer.

FromCenter.description: Center the devices were sent from.

ToCenter.description: Center the devices were sent to.

DeviceSerials.description: Serial numbers of devices in this transfer. To get device details, query device with SerialNumber.

DeviceCount.description: Number of devices in the transfer.

DeviceTypes.description: Distinct device types in this transfer.

prebuilt_kit.description: A pre-built kit (PBK): a packaged kit assembled ahead of time. One row per PBK. Use it for PBK status, center, expiration, kit, bundle, order, and part numbers inside it.

PBKSerialNumber.description: The pre-built kit's package serial number (a whole number). This is what users type to identify a PBK.

PBKStatus.description: Current status of the pre-built kit.

BundleId.description: Internal GUID of the bundle in this PBK. Users never type this; use it to find the bundle's devices (query device with BundleId).

BundleNumber.description: Bundle number shown to users (a whole number).

Kit.description: Name of the kit this PBK is built from.

OrderStatus.description: Status of the order this PBK belongs to.

OrderType.description: Type of the order this PBK belongs to.

PartCount.description: Number of distinct parts in the PBK.

DeviceSerials.description: Serial numbers of devices in this PBK. To get device details, query device with SerialNumber.

DeviceCount.description: Number of devices in the PBK.

order_device.description: One line of an order: one device in one order. One row per order line. A device can be in many orders and an order has many devices, so use this to list ALL devices in an order, ALL orders a device has been in, or to count devices across orders (for example devices by type in pending orders).

OrderDeviceId.description: Internal ID of the order line. Users never type this.

OrderNumber.description: The order this line belongs to.

SerialNumber.description: Serial number of the device on this line.

DeviceType.description: Kind of device on this line, for example Holter or MCT.

BundleId.description: Internal GUID of the bundle this line belongs to. Users never type this.

BundleNumber.description: Bundle number this line belongs to.

bundle.description: A bundle: a group of devices packed together from a kit, used in orders and pre-built kits. One row per bundle. Use it for which kit a bundle is, and which devices, orders and pre-built kits it belongs to.

BundleId.description: Internal GUID of the bundle. Users never type this; use it to follow links.

BundleNumber.description: The bundle's own number. This is what users type to identify a bundle.

Kit.description: Name of the kit this bundle is built from.

DeviceSerials.description: Devices in this bundle. For details, query order_device with BundleId.

DeviceCount.description: Number of devices in the bundle.

OrderNumbers.description: Orders this bundle was shipped in.

kit.description: A kit type (a product template that bundles and pre-built kits are built from). One row per kit. Use it to list kits and see how many bundles and pre-built kits exist for each.

BundleCount.description: Number of bundles built from this kit.

PBKCount.description: Number of pre-built kits built from this kit.

attachment.description: A document (file) attached to an enrollment or another object. One row per attachment. Use it for an attachment's type, file format and which enrollment it belongs to. File contents are not available.

AttachmentId.description: The attachment's ID (a GUID), as listed in an enrollment's AttachmentIds.

ObjectType.description: What kind of object the attachment belongs to.

ObjectId.description: Internal ID of the object the attachment belongs to. Users never type this.

EnrollmentNumber.description: Enrollment this attachment belongs to (only for enrollment attachments).

EnrollmentId.description: Internal ID of the enrollment. Use it to follow the link.
